chapter_path_en: Risks and Methods of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing

stem: 金融行业在哪些方面容易受到洗钱风险的影响？(选择三项。)

options.A: 它须承担更严格的监管义务，并有严格的报告要求，以保护金融体系免受非法资金流动的影响，并确保市场稳定
options.B: 它投资于新技术和新系统，以确保能够有效且及时地发现金融犯罪
options.C: 它提供复杂的金融产品，这可能会使资金流动更难追踪
options.D: 它经常与高风险司法管辖区打交道，这可能会增加遭受金融犯罪的风险或受到监管不力的影响
options.E: 它的交易量很大，这使得识别可疑活动更具挑战性

stem_en: In what ways is the financial industry vulnerable to money laundering risks? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: It is subject to heightened regulatory obligations with strict reporting requirements to safeguard the financial system from illicit fund flows and ensure market stability
options_en.B: It invests in new technology and systems to ensure effective and timely detection of financial crime
options_en.C: It offers complex financial products, which can make fund flows harder to trace
options_en.D: It is frequently engaged with high-risk jurisdictions, which can increase exposure to financial crime or weak supervision
options_en.E: It has a large volume of transactions, which makes identifying suspicious activity more challenging
